title: Analysis code for Aquatic communities and water quality encode urban environmental gradients at contrasting spatial scales
description: Custom analysis and plotting code for the associated urban freshwater study. The repository contains regional and global analysis sources, upstream feature-processing sources, a portable input-based reproduction of the 78 regional water-quality correlations, and a table-verification utility. Scientific datasets are deposited separately and retain source-specific licences. See README.md and docs/reproduction_status.md for tested entry points and the remaining path and input requirements of archived scripts.
